Subject: Renewal MAP kickoff — usage review & uptake accelerator

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As we discussed, I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) focused on ensuring a smooth renewal while accelerating spend capture for the next 12 months. High-level goals I captured:

- Align stakeholders and timelines for renewal (target close: end of Aug)
- Review last 6 months of usage trends and identify underutilized features
- Pilot 2 upsell initiatives (multi-model routing + dedicated capacity trial)
- Define evaluation criteria and success metrics for each initiative

I've attached a draft MAP (RW-3247_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a usage snapshot (CSV) to seed the review. Can you confirm the stakeholders we should include from your side and whether the renewal authority will be procurement or clinical IT?

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff next week to confirm roles and milestones. I suggested the following internal Redwood attendees (looping them here so they're aware): Marcus (solutions), Laura (CS), Marissa (sales lead).

Action items for this thread:
1) Jordan / Priya — confirm names and preferred time for a kickoff call (30 min)
2) Marcus — quick review of the usage CSV and call out any technical constraints
3) Laura — prepare a short uptake playbook we can propose for the pilot

Thanks — I’ll hold a couple time slots and send a calendar invite once we hear back.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Quick technical read of the CSV — thanks for including it. Top notes: 

- Usage distribution is heavy on short-chat traffic; peak tokens per request are low, which is good for latency SLOs.
- We see a 3x spike on Monday mornings which suggests batch traffic from an internal job — worth validating with Jordan/Keller.
- For the proposed multi-model routing pilot, the SLA sample I’ll share covers 95th/99th token latency on m-follow/decoder variants and expected throughput per vGPU. I’ll attach a short packet to the calendar invite.

Requests from my side before kickoff:
- Jordan: can you confirm whether KV cache persistence (per-session) is required for the pilot? If yes, we’ll need to set longer session TTLs and size the KV cache accordingly.
- Olga/Laura: please flag any additional success metrics beyond usage uplift and latency (e.g., inference cost per 1k tokens, error rate on structured outputs).
